Solver

Source: R/widget_solver_ui.R
solver.Rd

Constructs a widget for specifying solver settings to generate a solution. This widget is designed to be used within a Shiny web application.

Usage

solver(
  project,
  feature_targets = get_golem_config("prioritization_feature_targets"),
  feature_weights = get_golem_config("prioritization_feature_weights"),
  cost_weights = get_golem_config("prioritization_cost_weights"),
  zone_colors = get_golem_config("zone_colors"),
  zone_locked_colors = get_golem_config("zone_locked_colors"),
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  id = NULL
)

Arguments

project

new_project() object.

feature_targets

numeric vector of values representing different options for setting target values for features. Defaults to get_golem_config("prioritization_feature_targets").

feature_weights

numeric vector of values representing different options for setting target weights for features. Defaults to get_golem_config("prioritization_feature_weights").

cost_weights

numeric vector of values representing different options for setting weights for costs. Defaults to get_golem_config("prioritization_cost_weights").

zone_colors

character vector of colors for each zone. Defaults to get_golem_config("zone_colors").

zone_locked_colors

character vector of colors for each zone. Defaults to get_golem_config("zone_locked_colors").

width

character width of the displayed widget. Defaults to NULL such that the widget is automatically sized.

height

character width of the displayed widget. Defaults to NULL such that the widget is automatically sized.

id

character HTML identifier for the widget. Defaults to NULL since these identifiers are not used by Shiny.

Server value

The widget sends the following values to the server:

start

This is sent when the "Solve!" button is clicked and it sends a list that contains the settings for generating a prioritization. See documentation for the settings parameter of solve_prioritization() for further details on the format of this value.

stop

This is sent when the stop button is clicked.

See also

Other functions for the solver widget: solver-shiny, solver_add_lock(), solver_reset(), solver_sync()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# run example application showing a solver widget
run_example_app("solver")
}
